# What fuse-figma's `test:compare` self-check reads, as git pathspecs, one per line. On a PR with
# a known base, the merge workflow's figma-compare job skips the render when none of these changed
# (.github/scripts/figma-compare-affected.sh); a manual dispatch or an unknown base renders.
# test/merge-task-graph.test.mjs checks that every package the task's turbo graph builds and every
# file Turbo hashes for it is listed. A path listed too broadly costs a render; one left out lets a
# change skip the check.

# fuse-figma's sources and scripts
packages/fuse-figma
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/README.md
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/test
:(exclude)packages/fuse-figma/plugin
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse-figma/**/*.test.ts

# The Fuse build the cells render, its build scripts, and the sources the kit reads directly
packages/fuse/src
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse/src/**/*.test.*
:(exclude,glob)packages/fuse/src/**/__snapshots__/**
packages/fuse/scripts
packages/fuse/package.json
packages/fuse/tsconfig.json
packages/fuse/tsdown.config.ts

# The color package, which Fuse's theme and the kit import from source
packages/color/src
:(exclude,glob)packages/color/src/**/*.test.*
packages/color/package.json

# The TypeScript config the builds extend
tooling/typescript

# Dependencies and the task graph
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
pnpm-workspace.yaml
patches
turbo.json

# The job and its setup

.github/figma-compare-inputs.txt

# The docs pages whose ledes the kit build reads, and their frontmatter reader

apps/docs/scripts/lib/page-frontmatter.ts
